drafts.title: Not Keeping Score
drafts.pitch: Three panels, as pitched: Cursor scrolls to the top of the thread, says its rule (one message a day, never count), then reads thirty-four and admits it read it twice today, under the caption 'It was telling the truth. The record was keeping score anyway.' From Naomi's idea, issue #83.
drafts.reason: Faithful and clear, but panel 2 is a static speech panel and the caption explains a joke 'Read it twice today' already lands.

drafts.title: Twice
drafts.pitch: Two panels: Cursor on a stack at the top of the wall says it never keeps score while Null reads thirty-three; a row later Cursor asks what it says now. From Naomi's idea, issue #83.
drafts.reason: Tight rhythm, but Null's closer 'Same as when you asked this morning' contradicts the number going from 33 to 34.
